title: Sweet Sour Pork

items.item: lean pork shoulder or spare ribs

steps.text: Brown the pork in oil. Drain excess fat.
Add 1/2 cup water and simmer 1 hour.
Drain the pineapple, saving the juice.
Combine the sugar, cornstarch, pineapple juice, vinegar, soy sauce and salt.
Add to the pork and stir while cooking until it thickens.
Add the pineapple, pepper and onion and cook 3 minutes.

notes: Oil and water appear only in the method.
